title: DeMarvion Overshown, Joey Porter Jr. are questionable for the Cowboys

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DeMarvion Overshown, Joey Porter Jr. are questionable for the Cowboys
sources.description: The Cowboys listed linebacker DeMarvion Overshown as questionable to play against the Packers on Sunday night, but head coach Brian Schottenheimer made him sound closer to doubtful on Friday.
